verdict.rationale: Supabase Realtime documents Presence ('Track and synchronize user state across clients... showing who's online') and Broadcast ('Send low-latency messages between clients... cursor tracking, game events'). Together these deliver both halves of the story as first-party features, and the docs cite chat apps with typing indicators and online presence as a use case. Missing for 10: in-depth API/usage documentation in the pack (channel setup, presence sync/join/leave events, authorization on channels), independent or hands-on corroboration of Presence/Broadcast behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track user presence and broadcast ephemeral state between connected clients

citations.quote: Presence: Track and synchronize user state across clients. Ideal for showing who's online, or active participants.
Broadcast: Send low-latency messages between clients. Perfect for real-time messaging, database changes, cursor tracking, game events, and custom notifications.
Chat applications - Real-time messaging with typing indicators and online presence
